subject: Post-demo: proposed trial kickoff & evaluation milestones (Bluehaven)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Zhang <lucy@bluehaven.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: proposed trial kickoff & evaluation milestones (Bluehaven)

Lucy —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side plus a proposed trial kickoff plan so we can align on success criteria and owners. I kept this high level; attached is a 1-page charter and a sample ingestion spec for your eng team.

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Bluehaven is primarily validating Redwood for real-time customer message categorization and intent extraction (avg message length ~150 tokens).
- Success bar: >= 92% precision on top-1 intent for the 3 priority flows, end-to-end latency < 200ms p50, and stable throughput of ~400 rps during simulated peak.
- Data flow: messages will be sent via HTTPS -> Redwood hosted endpoint in us-west with prefix caching enabled.

Proposed 3-week trial (week-by-week):
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + environment access. Redwood spins up a dedicated trial sandbox and shares ingest guide. (Owner: Jordan / Bluehaven eng lead)
2) Week 1: Ingestion + smoke tests. Run initial 10k message pass to validate tokenization / edge cases. (Owner: Bluehaven eng)
3) Week 2: Evaluation & tuning. Run two evaluation sets (dev / holdout), measure precision/latency, iterate prompt/quantization settings with Redwood SRE. (Owners: Ben + Monica)
4) Week 3: Acceptance & next steps. Final report, recommended config for Dedicated or Hosted, and commercial conversations.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm Bluehaven's eng lead (who will own ingestion) and preferred date for kickoff?
- Can your team share an initial 1,000 anonymized sample messages by end of day Friday? If not possible, we can use synthetics to start.
- We propose a kickoff call Monday 10am PT — is that workable?

Attachments: Bluehaven_trial_charter_v1.pdf, sample_ingestion_spec.xlsx

If this looks reasonable I’ll schedule the kickoff and loop in our SRE for the onboarding window.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference (latency, cost, reliability)

- I’ll be the PM for this effort and Alex Kim (cc’d) will be the eng lead owning ingestion.
- We can share 1,000 anonymized messages by Friday EOD; Alex will validate format against your sample spec tomorrow.
